Name: PureBinarySave (LoadSaveFaster)
Author: palmhacker13
Description:
[center]
[size=7][b][color=#d48806]PureBinarySave[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4][i]Instant bedtime saves and sub-second save loading for Stardew Valley 1.6+[/i][/size]

[b][color=#1890ff]Zero-Allocation Binary Streaming[/color]  •  [color=#52c41a]Speculative Preload 2.0[/color]  •  [color=#fa8c16]100% Reversible Vanilla XML[/color][/b]
[/center]

[line]

[size=5][b]📖 Why PureBinarySave?[/b][/size]

In heavily modded Stardew Valley playthroughs, save files are stored as huge uncompressed XML text files (often [b]15–30+ MB[/b]). Writing and parsing all that text causes long black-screen pauses at bedtime and slow loading screens.

[b]PureBinarySave[/b] solves this cleanly without ever locking you into a custom format:
[list=1]
[*][b]Ultra-Compact Binary Format:[/b] Uses MessagePack + LZ4 zero-allocation streaming to shrink 30 MB saves down to ~900 KB [font=Courier New].bin[/font] files.[/*]
[*][b]Instant Bedtime Transitions:[/b] Saves to [font=Courier New].bin[/font] first when you go to sleep so you wake up at 6:00 AM without waiting.[/*]
[*][b]Deferred Vanilla XML Mirroring:[/b] Quietly syncs a genuine vanilla XML backup in the background after you wake up—so save editors, web tools, and vanilla compatibility remain intact.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]✨ Key Features & 2.0 Engine Upgrades[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Speculative Preload 2.0:[/b] Utilizes idle time on the title screen (and save-slot hover) to decompress and prepare save data in memory with instant byte-level cancellation ([font=Courier New]CancellableMemoryStream[/font]) and zero main-thread contention.[/*]
[*][b]Post-Load Optimization:[/b] Lazy TileSheets, Map Prewarming, and Fast Fade eliminate post-load hitching on large farms.[/*]
[*][b]Cross-Save State Isolation:[/b] Safely isolates Community Center bundles, rewards, and Museum pieces during background preloading so data never bleeds between saves.[/*]
[*][b]Rollback & Backup Sync ([font=Courier New].bin.sync[/font]):[/b] Automatically detects if you restored an older [font=Courier New]_old[/font] or SMAPI backup and re-syncs cleanly without overwriting your restored XML.[/*]
[*][b]Mod-Friendly & Safe:[/b] Uses the game's native [font=Courier New]SaveGame.serializer[/font] and works seamlessly with [b]SpaceCore[/b], [b]Content Patcher[/b], and multiplayer.[/*]
[*][b]Built-in A/B Benchmarking:[/b] Test binary vs. vanilla XML speed anytime with [font=Courier New]pbs_mode [binary|xml][/font] or [font=Courier New]pbs_status[/font].[/*]
[*][b]One-Click Safe Uninstall:[/b] Run [font=Courier New]pbs_revert_all[/font] (or toggle it in MCM/GMCM) to restore 100% clean vanilla XML files before removing the mod.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]📌 First-Time Setup Note[/b][/size]

[quote]
[list]
[*][b]Existing Saves:[/b] Your very first load after installing will take the normal vanilla time (since only XML exists). Once you sleep and save once, the [font=Courier New].bin[/font] file is created—every load and bedtime save after that runs at full binary speed![/*]
[*][b]New Saves:[/b] Enjoy full binary speed right after Day 1.[/*]
[*][b]Wait a few seconds after waking up before Alt+F4[/b] so the background XML backup finishes syncing (around 5–6 seconds).[/*]
[/list][/quote]
[line]

[size=5][b]💻 Useful Console Commands[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][font=Courier New][b]pbs_status[/b][/font] — View load/save timing breakdown and file size comparison.[/*]
[*][font=Courier New][b]pbs_mode [binary|xml][/b][/font] — Switch between binary and vanilla XML for A/B testing.[/*]
[*][font=Courier New][b]restore_xml <SaveFolder>[/b][/font] — Rebuild XML from [font=Courier New].bin[/font] (great before sharing saves or using Stardew Checkup).[/*]
[*][font=Courier New][b]pbs_revert_all[/b][/font] — Restore all saves to clean vanilla XML and remove [font=Courier New].bin[/font] files.[/*]
[/list]
[line]
